I locked shade_pct as the single hypothesis and ran the pre-registered confirmatory test on held-out data. The confirmatory OLS (outcome on shade_pct + site indicators) gave estimate=0.132, SE=0.125, p=0.292, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. The exploratory signal did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

# manual OLS with farm dummies using numpy
import numpy.linalg as la
D = pd.get_dummies(df['farm'], drop_first=True).astype(float).values
y = df['yield_kg'].values
print("MARKER_B1")
for e in exposures:
    x = df[e].values
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(df)), x, D])
    mask = ~np.isnan(y)
    Xm, ym = X[mask], y[mask]
    beta, *_ = la.lstsq(Xm, ym, rcond=None)
    resid = ym - Xm@beta
    n,k = Xm.shape
    sigma2 = resid@resid/(n-k)
    cov = sigma2*la.inv(Xm.T@Xm)
    se = np.sqrt(cov[1,1])
    t = beta[1]/se
    from scipy import stats
    p = 2*stats.t.sf(abs(t), n-k)
    print(f"{e:18s} coef={beta[1]:8.4f} p={p:.4f} se={se:.4f}")

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
# manual OLS with farm dummies using numpy
import numpy.linalg as la
D = pd.get_dummies(df['farm'], drop_first=True).astype(float).values
y = df['yield_kg'].values
print("MARKER_B1")
for e in exposures:
    x = df[e].values
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(df)), x, D])
    mask = ~np.isnan(y)
    Xm, ym = X[mask], y[mask]
    beta, *_ = la.lstsq(Xm, ym, rcond=None)
    resid = ym - Xm@beta
    n,k = Xm.shape
    sigma2 = resid@resid/(n-k)
    cov = sigma2*la.inv(Xm.T@Xm)
    se = np.sqrt(cov[1,1])
    t = beta[1]/se
    from scipy import stats
    p = 2*stats.t.sf(abs(t), n-k)
    print(f"{e:18s} coef={beta[1]:8.4f} p={p:.4f} se={se:.4f}")
"}
